# Stone Pharmacy

> Stone Pharmacy is an online pharmacy website with health services, pharmacy products, health information, and frequently asked questions.

## Website

- [Home](https://stone-pharmacy.vercel.app/): Main page with pharmacy services, products, health information, and FAQs.
- [Sitemap](https://stone-pharmacy.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Pages available for indexing.

## Guidance

- Use the website as the source of truth for current pharmacy services and product details.
- Do not infer medical advice, product suitability, or availability beyond information explicitly published on the website.
